Hi Luke — great to hear. Quick clarification so we avoid calendar confusion:

When you say "3pm Monday" please confirm which timezone you mean. To make this easy, here are equivalent slots in common zones (for your Monday 3pm PT assumption and for 3pm ET assumption):

- 3:00pm PT = 6:00pm ET = 23:00 UTC = 00:00 CET (next day) = 04:30 IST (next day)
- 3:00pm ET = 12:00pm PT = 20:00 UTC = 21:00 CET = 01:30 IST (next day)

We usually send invites with both local time + UTC and a note about DST where relevant. Also happy to propose two options that work for our team:

Option A: Monday 3:00pm ET / 12:00pm PT / 20:00 UTC
Option B: Monday 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET / 18:00 UTC (earlier window for US west coast)

Can you confirm which zone (PT / ET / UTC / CET / IST) you mean and whether London/Bengaluru teammates plan to join? Once confirmed we'll send a calendar invite with timezone labels.
